CREATE VIEW vw_weekday_weekend_demand AS

WITH trips AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://adlstransproject.dfs.core.windows.net/transportationdata/curated_parquet/trips/**',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS t
),
routes AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://adlstransproject.dfs.core.windows.net/transportationdata/curated_parquet/routes/**',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS r
),
stations AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://adlstransproject.dfs.core.windows.net/transportationdata/curated_parquet/stations/**',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS s
),
trip_analysis AS (
    SELECT
        t.trip_id,
        t.route_id,
        r.route_name,
        t.pickup_station,
        t.dropoff_station,
        t.pickup_zone,
        t.dropoff_zone,
        t.passenger_count,
        t.fare_egp,
        t.trip_distance_km,
        t.payment_method,
        t.trip_datetime,
        t.hour_of_day,
        t.day_of_week,

        CASE
            WHEN t.day_of_week IN ('Friday', 'Saturday')
                THEN 'Weekend'
            ELSE 'Weekday'
        END AS trip_period

    FROM trips t

    LEFT JOIN routes r
        ON t.route_id = r.route_name
)

SELECT
    trip_period,
    pickup_zone,

    COUNT(DISTINCT trip_id) AS total_trips,

    SUM(passenger_count) AS total_passengers,

    ROUND(SUM(fare_egp * passenger_count), 2) AS total_revenue,

    MIN(hour_of_day) AS first_active_hour,

    MAX(hour_of_day) AS last_active_hour

FROM trip_analysis

GROUP BY
    trip_period,
    pickup_zone

HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;
